transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Basically, what brings me in is... well, most nights, after my wife goes to bed, I end up in the kitchen. And I just eat way past a normal plate of food. 

I'll get into whatever we have—fried chicken, mac and cheese, sweet potatoes, rolls, or whatever leftovers are in there from an event. I just keep going until a whole tray is empty, or honestly, until half the fridge is just gone.
After these episodes of eating, do you ever feel the need to try and get rid of the food, such as by vomiting, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

No, I don't do any of that. I don't try to make myself throw up or take laxatives or anything. And I'm definitely not working out afterwards. I mostly just... sit there feeling completely stuffed and awful about it, and then I eventually just go to sleep.
